data.text: E1 money module written 2026-10-19, before the first counted Probe B conversation (the 2026-10-17 call was a demo and does not count). Q-M1..Q-M4 with the rule (after the core, never name the problem first, no pitch, past behaviour first) and pre-set marks: Q-M1 >= 2 of 5 dated cross-repo story with a cost; Q-M3 split >= 3 of 5 decides App vs Action; Q-M4 split >= 3 of 5 flat vs per person decides DEC-63's comparison arm, the closing hypothetical counts toward nothing. Q-M3 no longer says 'one folder': a GitHub App reads whole selected repositories. Files (on disk, not in git): docs/research/interview-script.md (new section before Phase 5), docs/research/probe-b-results.md (E1 count table + per-conversation fields), docs/research/monetization-discovery-2026-10.md (Q-M3 fixed with a note, Q-M4 and its split added). Mirrored in the private outreach workspace: call guide, results template, reference script copy, insights log.
